newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Galleon with treasure found off Ecuador coast.
newsitem.headline: Galleon with treasure found off Ecuador coast.

text.p: An international group said on Tuesday they have located a Spanish galleon that sunk in 1654 off the Ecuadorean Pacific coast with a multimillion-dollar cargo of gold and silver.

"The galleon was discovered on March 8," Roni Almeida, an Ecuadorean who heads the expedition, told Reuters. "It was detected by our electronic equipment off the coast town of Punta Carnero," 360 miles (570 km) south of Quito.
Almeida declined to give more details on the location of the galleon "because first we must present a report to the Ecuadorean government in the next few days."
The team headed by Almeida includes American, Norwegian, Uruguayan and Spanish nationals.
It was not immediately clear how the silver and gold booty, which Almeida claims could be worth billions of dollars, would be divided once it is retrieved.
A government spokesman, saying he was not aware of the finding, declined to comment on the subject.
